title: Early Prediction of Cognitive Deficit in Very Preterm Infants Using Brain Structural Connectome With Transfer Learning Enhanced Deep Convolutional Neural Networks.
summary: Transfer-learning-enhanced deep networks using preterm-infant brain structural connectomes predicted cognitive deficits at follow-up, linking neonatal imaging to later developmental outcomes.
